cards.title: Current Repo Boundary Stop-Line
allowed: bounded cleanup that removes parent-workspace assumptions
forbidden: reintroducing a sibling workspace as a required parent
treating archived logs as active instructions
compatibility shims that hide missing repo structure instead of fixing it
cards.rollbackPath: Revert the bounded docs, script, or manifest change that crossed the repo boundary.
cards.reopenCriteria: Only reopen external-coupling work if a concrete integration requirement is identified and documented.

cards.title: Current Scope Stop-Line
allowed: templates, handoff discipline, and small helper scripts
forbidden: building a full agent runtime or orchestrator inside this repo
cards.rollbackPath: Remove the new surface and return to the previous documented workflow contract.
cards.reopenCriteria: Only expand scope when a smaller verified slice can no longer solve the active problem.

cards.title: Current Loop Execution Stop-Line
allowed: limited automation only when its inputs, outputs, and stop conditions are explicit
forbidden: autonomous execution without stop-lines or proof path
unverified state mutation across external repos
planner-driven execution claims without working verification
cards.rollbackPath: Disable or remove the loop helper while preserving the written logs it already produced.
cards.reopenCriteria: Only broaden execution authority after a concrete use case exists and the verification surface is already in place.
